title: Network Policy
description: Workload dependencies from Hubble metrics and Cilium policy drops. Use it to review a workload before writing its policy and to find missing rules afterwards.

options.content: Counts are new connections (TCP SYN, plus UDP/SCTP packets) over the selected time range. Apps are identified by their `app.kubernetes.io/name`, `k8s-app` or `app` label, so components of one app share a name. `source`/`destination` name non-pod peers such as `reserved:host` or `reserved:world`. Internet destinations are not recorded; private (LAN) destinations appear by IP. Long-lived connections opened before the time range, or before metrics began on 2026-11-21, do not appear: confirm clients from configuration before restricting ingress. `POLICY_DENIED` means no rule allowed the connection; `POLICY_DENY` is an explicit deny. See `k8s/OPERATIONS.md` for live inspection with Hubble.

panels.title: Outbound connections
panels.description: Connections this app opened to pods and cluster peers, observed on the source node.

targets.expr: sum by (destination_namespace, destination_app, destination, port, protocol) (increase(hubble_port_distribution_total{traffic_direction="egress", source_namespace="$namespace", source_app="$app"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Inbound connections
panels.description: Connections to this app, observed on the destination node.

targets.expr: sum by (source_namespace, source_app, source, port, protocol) (increase(hubble_port_distribution_total{traffic_direction="ingress", destination_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: LAN destinations
panels.description: Connections from this app to private addresses outside the cluster. DROPPED rows were blocked by policy.

targets.expr: sum by (destination_ip, port, protocol, verdict) (increase(hubble_flows_to_world_total{source_namespace="$namespace", source_app="$app"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Drops involving this app
panels.description: Packets Cilium dropped to or from this app.

targets.expr: sum by (traffic_direction, source_namespace, source_app, source, destination_namespace, destination_app, destination, reason, protocol) (increase(hubble_drop_total{source_namespace="$namespace", source_app="$app"}[$__range]) or increase(hubble_drop_total{destination_namespace="$namespace", destination_app="$app"}[$__range])) > 0

panels.title: Drops involving this app by reason
Endpoints by policy enforcement
panels.description: Pods enforcing policy in each direction. The default-deny goal is zero endpoints with enforcement none.

panels.title: Sustained missing-rule drops
panels.description: Pairs with POLICY_DENIED drops (excluding ICMP) in at least one five-minute window of the last hour, with the number of windows. CiliumPolicyDenied fires at 8 of 12.

targets.expr: count_over_time((sum by (source_namespace, source_app, source, destination_namespace, destination_app, destination, traffic_direction) (increase(hubble_drop_total{reason="POLICY_DENIED", protocol!~"ICMP.*"}[5m])) > 0)[1h:5m])

sum by (traffic_direction, source_namespace, source_app, source, destination_namespace, destination_app, destination) (rate(hubble_drop_total{reason="POLICY_DENIED", protocol!~"ICMP.*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0
